name: io.github.zachshallbetter/adobe-mcp-suite
title: Adobe MCP Suite
description: Drive Adobe InDesign and Illustrator from one MCP server, with tools that work across both.

environmentVariables.name: ADOBE_MCP_APPS
environmentVariables.description: Applications to load, comma-separated: indesign, illustrator. Default all

environmentVariables.name: INDESIGN_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories InDesign tools may read and write (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: ILLUSTRATOR_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories Illustrator tools may read and write (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)
